In causative stems, the meaning sharpens: to actively weaken another's resolve (Jer 38:4), to abandon someone entirely (Deut 31:6), or — memorably — to command stillness before God (Ps 46:10, 'Be still and know that I am the LORD').     Enriched: Piel sense of physically letting something drop or letting down — the concrete, mechanical action. Job 12:21 describes God loosening the belt of the mighty (Spanish 'afloja').
